pick.text: Both of these sides possess plenty of quality, so a draw and both teams to score may be a smart combination.

pick.text: With their current goalscoring run in away games, backing Bologna to score 2-4 times in this match looks like a strong option.

pick.text: Given Forest’s attacking issues and that Chelsea have drawn blanks in two of their last three away league games, there could be value in backing against both teams to score.

strengths.away: Blanked in two of their last three away league games; Caicedo doubt after a back injury.
